findings.title: Production provision/deploy ran destructive Terraform with no approval (fixed)
Security scans were non-blocking (fixed)
findings.note: Trivy image scan now exit-code 1 for HIGH/CRITICAL.

findings.title: `infra-development` destroys infra on every push to `develop`
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot CI-P2-001; workflow provisions and deletes duplicate droplets on develop.
evidence: workflow deletes older droplets via DO API
findings.impact: Self-inflicted dev outages; destructive without an environment gate.
findings.recommendation: Gate behind `environment: development` with manual approval, or scope to a dry run.

findings.title: Auto-commit workflows hold `contents: write` and push to main/develop
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot CI-P2-003; both workflows still request contents:write.
findings.impact: Compromised workflow can rewrite the default branch.
findings.recommendation: Use a scoped bot token / PR-based update instead of direct push.

findings.title: `develop` (auto-deploy target) is not covered by the branch-protection gate
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot CI-P2-004; validate.yml branch-protection job hard-codes main.
findings.impact: Auto-deploy branch has no enforced review/required checks.
findings.recommendation: Extend the gate to develop or make production only deploy from a protected branch.

findings.title: `workflow_dispatch` inputs interpolated into `run:` (script injection) (fixed)
findings.note: Closed with the actionlint/CI hardening wave (#97).
evidence: audit workflows now pass inputs via env, actionlint clean

findings.title: 13 workflows omit an explicit `permissions:` block
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot CI-P3-002; measured at a62e44a.
findings.impact: Default token scope is broader than needed.
findings.recommendation: Add least-privilege permissions to every workflow.

report:
Inspected all 22 workflows. Production
deploy/provision is gated behind the protected `production` environment;
security scans block; rollback executes. Residuals: destructive dev infra
workflow, auto-commit write scope, develop not branch-protected, and 13
workflows without explicit `permissions:`.
